[[:File:Icedome non-interactive map.jpg|Non-interactive map]] | ingame name=Icedome | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=087 }} The [[Icedome]] is a small area between [[Talus Chute]] and the [[Frozen Forest]]. The [[Stone Summit]] maintain a heavy presence here. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Carver]] * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Summit Giant Herder]] * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Ranger]] * {{mo}} 24 (26) [[Dolyak Master]] * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Gnasher]] * {{me}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Heretic]] [[Elemental]]s * {{e}} 24 (26) [[Siege Ice Golem]] == Notes == * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.44% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 130|low = 120|high = 141}} ** Many enemy groups are close together, so [[pull]] carefully to avoid taking on more than one mob at the same time. ** Some players find it better to enter from [[Talus Chute]], because your party will get aggroed immediately when arriving from the [[Frozen Forest]]. ** There is a group of two Stone Summit that roam around the eastern portion of the map counter-clockwise that can be missed if not encountered with other foes, which may require you to trace your path. ** The Mission Map will sometime fail to capture and track the player's location within Icedome, causing it's position to not be centered. {{anomaly| The map beyond the portal to Talus Chute doesn't extend far enough. When looking in the distance, a sea can be seen. After crossing the portal, that sea is replaced with mountains.}} == Trivia == *[[Cursed Lands]] (non-[[War in Kryta]] area), [[Tasca's Demise]] and [[Icedome]] are the only areas in Prophecies without a friendly NPC (aside of [[Nicholas the Traveler]]). [[Dreadnought's Drift]] is a similar case, but has one conditional temporary friendly NPC in the form of the [[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]]. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Eisdom]]
